name: Extra Field Configuration
description: Provides a configuration manager to attach extra fields to entity types.
provides_plugin_types: ExtraField/Display (managed by plugin.manager.extra_field_configuration_display, discovered via ExtraFieldConfigurationDeriver; reuses extra_field's @ExtraFieldDisplay annotation)
project_description: Configuration layer for the Extra Field contrib module. Instead of declaring an extra field's entity/bundle placement in the plugin annotation's 'bundles' property (as plain Extra Field requires), site builders create ExtraFieldConfiguration config entities (config_prefix 'display') at /admin/structure/extra-field that bind an @ExtraFieldDisplay plugin to any fieldable entity type/bundle displays. A single plugin can back many named instances, so the same extra field can be reused multiple times on one entity without defining duplicate plugin classes. A plugin opts in by adding deriver = ExtraFieldConfigurationDeriver to its annotation (and omitting 'bundles'); ExtraFieldConfigurationDisplayManager (a subclass of extra_field's ExtraFieldDisplayManager) then discovers only those plugins, and the deriver turns each saved config entity into a derived plugin definition carrying the configured bundles. hook_entity_extra_field_info() exposes the derived fields to Manage display; hook_entity_view() renders them, renaming the internal 'extra_field_{plugin}:{id}' build key to 'extra_field_{id}' for Twig. All CRUD (list/add/edit/delete) is gated by the 'administer extra fields' permission. An optional extra_field_configuration_examples submodule ships ExampleField and ExampleFormattedField sample plugins. Extra Field Plus plugins also work.
